description: Only what the main window needs: the core API, the native file dialogs used to pick an archive, a destination directory and a target file, a message dialog to explain what a scan left out, and writing an entry name to the clipboard. Handing a file to the desktop is deliberately absent: the row menu goes through the open_entry command instead, which builds the path itself, so no command taking an arbitrary path to open is reachable from the window.
